d:
Anant Singh News: anant sinh ki bari beti ki shadi men samastipur ke raja ghora ne alto kar jiti thi, ab chhoti beti shivangi ki shadi men unka beta jay vijay ghora lekar pahuncha hai.
Is bar uski najar thar par hai, jise jitne ke lie ghurdaur men hissa liya ja raha hai.
Aakhir anant sinh ki donon betiyon ki shadi se is ghore aur parivar ka kya hai khas kanekshan? dekhie puri kahani.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
